title: Project foundation and reference capture
build: Create repository, clean build pipeline, editor/package lock, naming rules, ID registry, input shell and ownership of every first-sprint task. Capture a licensed local INSIDE reference session and compare observations to the proposed metrics.
assets: Metric block meshes, temporary Ivo capsule, neutral material, original placeholder glyphs, reference review template.
systems: Bootstrap, build automation, test runner and basic settings; no external account needed to launch.
playable: Packaged executable opens a metric room and exits cleanly on two machines.
tests: Clean checkout/build, controller recognition, package compatibility, source-license inventory and initial frame-time capture.
problems: Unreproducible local setup, unsupported package combination, accidental external-service dependency, copied reference assets.
exit_gate: Technical lead signs a reproducible clean-machine build; director signs evidence-versus-assumption reference sheet; producer assigns M01–M09 owners.

title: Movement and interaction prototype
build: Build the controller gym: run/stop/turn, gaps, slopes, steps, ledges, ladders, crouch, chair push and rejected heavy interaction. Establish socket and hand-occupation rules.
assets: Temporary Ivo rig, locomotion/interaction clips, simple contact surfaces and grip points.
systems: Input, lane motor, buffering, ledge queries, interaction resolver, initial presentation state.
playable: A five-minute traversal loop with no debug-only movement and a controller/keyboard alternative.
tests: Thirty, sixty and 120 fps; reversal responsiveness; capsule clearance; wrong approach; remapping; sustained-input assistance.
problems: Sliding feet, delayed valid jumps, inconsistent step height, root-motion penetration, ambiguous target choice.
exit_gate: Routine gap and stop tests pass repeatedly; fresh users can move and interact without verbal coaching; movement values are recorded, not hidden in prefabs.

title: Central Hold mechanic prototype
build: Implement slider/rotator drivers, one personal owner, transfer anchor, support capture, range warning and resumable release. Add the live ownership graph.
assets: Shutter, tread, single socket, anchor, brace vane and support block; temporary sounds and hand poses.
systems: Mechanism drivers, atomic transactions, ownership validation, hand requirements and initial state serialization.
playable: A repeatable gym that arrests, transfers, resumes and physically supports the same mechanisms.
tests: Transfer/release on adjacent ticks, two requests for one owner, leaving range, pause/device cancellation, reload while held.
problems: Double owners, free-fall transfer frame, unlimited stored impulse, random target changes, water/time-freeze ambiguity.
exit_gate: Ownership and release invariants pass automated fixtures; a tester describes what stops and what continues; no random power failures.

title: First complete puzzle prototype
build: Build first shutter/tread and a small support-relief fixture. Include entry observation, wrong-angle recovery, solved-state checkpoint and exit predicate.
assets: Gameplay-grade shutter/tread collision, support pawl, marker-free camera volumes and basic foot/hand audio.
systems: Moving support, swept crush, support graph, puzzle facts and local reset.
playable: A six-to-eight-minute room sequence with an actual solution and recoverable failed approaches.
tests: Watch unfamiliar players without hints; attempt wrong order and edge jumps; restart before/after support.
problems: Puzzle only understandable from debug labels, unstable physics, excessive waiting, unnecessary repeat traversal.
exit_gate: Solution follows visible causality; repeated success does not depend on a lucky collision; reset restores a solvable arrangement.

title: Core gameplay loop and narrative-state prototype
build: Join arrival, observation, manipulation, bodily response, traversal and consequence. Implement sequence facts and event phases, not only disconnected test rooms.
assets: Small service route, bearer-hand placeholder, first contextual after-motion, coherent ambient bed.
systems: Sequence exits, ledger, checkpoints, idempotent events, debug fixture loading.
playable: Ten-minute continuous route including a transfer and an early hint of a hidden bearer.
tests: Quit/reload at each event phase; distinguish useful action from disturbing consequence; measure dead time.
problems: Narrative props unrelated to puzzle, event duplication, camera taking control for too long, compulsory confusion.
exit_gate: Full loop works from menu to checkpoint resume; player understanding and uncertainty match the intended stage.

title: Horror and tension prototype
build: Build thin-sheet/thick-blanket visibility and a restrained-body reveal. Tune anticipation, pause, approach and release rather than adding random scares.
assets: Two cloth types, search light, restrained torso with eyes/breath, directional sound layers and caption alternatives.
systems: Visibility tags, camera composition, audio state and interruptible narrative reaction.
playable: An eight-minute tension route with one safe teaching moment, one threat and one quiet realization.
tests: Muted audio, low brightness, grayscale and reduced-motion modes; ask what the player believed was alive and aware.
problems: Unreadable cover, scare sting doing all the work, apparent robot rather than person, repetition exposing scripted trick.
exit_gate: Players explain the danger before failure and notice continuing awareness without exposition; sensory cues agree.

title: Custodian and Porter prototypes
build: Implement both threat families, including covered/exposed harnesses and Porter detect/reach/secure/retract. Build sack demonstration, chase obstruction and rescue-dock behavior in fixtures.
assets: Rough adult rigs, Porter carriage/rail/hose, exposed socket, capture poses, readable warning sounds.
systems: Perception, route pursuit, harness restraint, swept capture and Porter load zones.
playable: Separate representative Custodian and Porter encounters with correct retries.
tests: Sight obstruction, last-known position, no teleport, one-Hold allocation, capture from moving supports, repeated pause.
problems: Unexplained detection, unavoidable rail reach, decorative shields treated as immunity, capture through barriers.
exit_gate: Each encounter can be predicted from its teaching event and debug trace; ten repeated retries remain solvable.

title: First integrated environment and pipeline
build: Bring a Laundry bay to representative environment quality while creating reusable import, lighting, camera and streaming workflows.
assets: One final-quality wall/column/rail kit, Ivo material benchmark, laundry cart, sheet, anchor, lighting and VFX bundle.
systems: Streaming, camera, contact IK, pooled audio/VFX, asset validator and capture tool.
playable: Five-to-eight-minute packaged environment with genuine transitions rather than editor teleport.
tests: Lighting-only readability, floor-device profiling, cold load, backwards movement, material scale and socket import.
problems: Photorealistic noise, hidden path, texture inconsistency, hitches, hand penetration, art requiring bespoke scripts.
exit_gate: Art/audio leads approve gameplay-camera benchmark; import and performance evidence are repeatable on clean assets.

title: Swimming and air-bell risk prototype
build: Build bounded water, head-air tests, breath/recovery, one-arm Hold swimming, guided bell and obsolete tipping dock.
assets: Swim poses, basic water shader, bell/winch/hose, pocket debug volume and submerged Porter variant.
systems: Water graph, swimming motor, breath assistance, buoyancy constraints and coherent water snapshots.
playable: A ten-minute underwater route from first swim to moving air pocket and escape from the retrieve-and-tip apparatus.
tests: Surface thrash, breath exploit, timed swim legs, bell pose restore, input switching, accessibility and low effects.
problems: Invisible air rules, camera hiding the next opening, pocket that never spills, cheap drowning, free physics softlocks.
exit_gate: New players understand where breath exists; route margins and coherent reloads pass; dock danger is visibly caused by tipping.

title: Reciprocal balance and Walking Ward risk proof
build: Build the quarry carrier, movable room and rough inhabited Ward on a support route. Implement narrow support, crouch and protected final release using synthetic prerequisite facts initially.
assets: Greybox hostel with two chimneys/curtain, four supports, cradle, simple occupants, girder, receiving pads, domestic sound cue.
systems: Shared station input, support graph, guided gait, room-local presentation, root-input guard; integrate real roster later.
playable: A twelve-to-fifteen-minute progression from small carrier to First Step and two Ward maneuvers.
tests: Do players transfer controls without a new tutorial? Do they care about occupants? Pause, release, off-focus and support restore.
problems: Comedy robot tone, unrelated vehicle controls, impossible unsupported steps, tedious foot micromanagement, accidental ending.
exit_gate: Director/engineering/animation approve controllable and emotionally legible reversal; blocking risks resolved before bulk campaign art.

title: First fifteen-minute chronological build
build: Integrate actual kitchen, landing, transport, brace pickup, shutter and tread; stage the beginning of pursuit at the fifteen-minute boundary.
assets: Ivo/Anja production rigs, domestic props, landing/transport hardware, opening contacts and two-tap audio.
systems: Full opening event phases, saved brace ownership, controller UI, camera transition and checkpoints.
playable: The actual first fifteen minutes from a new game, not a montage of later rooms.
tests: Onboarding with no coaching, opening control within seconds, child/mother relationship, restart at transport phases.
problems: Exposition dependency, lengthy noninteractive intro, lost brace, confusing target, mother animations preventing progress.
exit_gate: Fresh players know whom they are following and can use Hold; every opening interruption resumes coherently.

title: First complete chapter
build: Finish C01 including full pursuit, exterior transition and hostel landmark. Add complete chapter save/quit/retry handling.
assets: Final C01 art/audio pass, Custodian doorway catch, garden threshold and landmark proxy.
systems: All chapter systems including streamed exit and durable DoorBlocked/BraceOwned state.
playable: The full approximately eighteen-minute Upper Terrace chapter in a packaged build.
tests: Entire chapter on keyboard/controller, low-spec preliminary profile, capture retries and fast traversal into next chunk.
problems: Chapter exit hitch, pursuit too hard after successful tutorial, landmark oversold, duplicated guards.
exit_gate: No blocker/softlock; all C01 sequence cards have signed design/engineering/art/audio/QA review.

title: First thirty-minute continuous build
build: Add the Gardens through its early Porter encounter, preserving the actual chronological path and weather/acoustic transition.
assets: Garden kit, windscreen, wader, sluice/float, loading terrace and Porter presentation.
systems: Flow diversion, natural ambient behavior, Porter teaching, streaming and cross-chapter ledger.
playable: First thirty active minutes without debug jumps; the remaining garden route may continue beyond this test boundary.
tests: Pacing, mechanic recurrence versus repetition, environmental variety, route inference and memory of Anja.
problems: Open area feels empty, reused angle puzzle overstays, water rules conflict, story urgency disappears.
exit_gate: C01–C02 transition works without a loading screen or reset; fresh-player timing data identifies revisions before art lock.

title: Shipping-quality vertical slice and flagship benchmark
build: Finish all four Laundry sequences at representative shipping quality. In parallel finish a three-to-six-minute First Step quality benchmark to prove the late-game art/animation/audio cost.
assets: Final Ivo, transfer bridge, sheet/rack/blanket systems, hand reveal, Custodian, room kit, full audio/mix/lighting; Ward hero interior and reveal subset.
systems: Movement, Hold, puzzles, stealth, saves, streaming, captions, performance capture and integrated presentation; final-quality Ward subset.
playable: Continuous twenty-four-minute Laundry chapter from entry to exit, plus separate flagship benchmark. Neither is passed by a trailer or static screenshot.
tests: At least two rounds of unfamiliar players, packaged floor-machine tests, long retry soak, pause/reload matrix, sensory sign-off and actual task-time logging.
problems: Beautiful but unreadable image, gameplay not matching benchmark, hand reveal missed, late-game feature hidden from budget, unrepeatable quality.
exit_gate: All disciplines sign a representative result; known blockers closed; measured throughput produces a revised staffing/schedule estimate before bulk production.

title: Full end-to-end playable campaign
build: Build all nine chapters in greybox or gameplay-grade art, including real underwater route, Anja reveal, discharge proof, twelve-person evacuation and canonical ending.
assets: Complete functional collision/rig/socket set; readable stand-in art/audio for all beats; no missing story-critical actor.
systems: All mandatory mechanics and dependencies integrated; synthetic finale flags replaced with real progression.
playable: New game to final fade with no editor commands, teleport, placeholder win button or skipped climax.
tests: Full fresh runs, chapter times, prerequisite graph, all checkpoints and story comprehension. Record per-sequence stalls and recurring failures.
problems: Late route contradiction, repetitive puzzle grammar, impossible body/hand use, unearned transformation, incomplete ending.
exit_gate: Every sequence has a working route, coherent reset and event chain; campaign reaches the actual ending. Content may be visually unfinished, but design is complete enough to estimate.

title: Alpha — feature and content complete
build: Finish every planned feature, sequence, mandatory asset family and supported setting; replace critical stand-ins; freeze new mechanics.
assets: All character/environment/puzzle assets present at alpha quality; complete animation and audio coverage; menus, captions and credits.
systems: Feature-complete gameplay, persistence, streaming, cohort, Ward, localization pipeline and release guard.
playable: Whole campaign with all player-facing systems and content represented; only polish/optimization/localization fixes remain.
tests: Regression suite, unsupported-order play, long-run memory, controller hotplug, all root phases and save migration fixtures.
problems: Feature creep, borrowed placeholder rights, missing accessibility, art that requires changed collision, content only working in editor.
exit_gate: No missing required feature or sequence; scope frozen; bug severity and polish backlog triaged; engine-support review completed.

title: Beta — stable representative experience
build: Resolve major usability/logic defects and bring the whole campaign close to intended final sensory quality. Conduct full external playtesting and localization review.
assets: Near-final lighting/animation/audio/VFX; localized UI/captions; approved reference screenshots and content disclosures.
systems: Stable saves and integrated quality settings; measured performance and recovery paths.
playable: Complete representative game suitable for an external test cohort under controlled distribution.
tests: Fresh full-playthrough median, narrative interviews, missed reveals, comfort/accessibility, minimum-spec matrix and save compatibility.
problems: Duration inflated by confusion, subtle cues unreadable, ending interpreted as arbitrary punishment, Ward repetition, low-spec lost information.
exit_gate: No progression blockers or reproducible save loss; key comprehension targets met; remaining work is bounded fixes/polish rather than redesign.

title: Optimization and final polish
build: Optimize measured CPU/GPU/memory bottlenecks and polish contact, camera, sound transitions and brief failures without changing the creative contract.
assets: LOD/texture/shader refinements, compressed audio policy, final contact clips, quality-tier profiles.
systems: Stable frame pacing, asset residency, pooling, loading, audio priorities and reduced-effects equivalents.
playable: Full game at agreed quality/performance tiers with final-length transitions and release candidate content.
tests: Cold/warm routes, maximum Ward view, long sessions, repeat respawns, shader warmup and hardware-specific faults.
problems: Optimizations alter physics, low settings hide danger, stripped animation events break puzzles, memory growth across reloads.
exit_gate: Measured budgets met on documented fixtures; all gameplay regressions rerun; no content removed silently to win a benchmark.

title: Release candidate and delivery rehearsal
build: Produce versioned candidates, freeze content, verify installation/update/uninstall and backup/restore. Finish rights, credits, store materials and support procedures.
assets: Final package, original captures/key art, licenses, credits, disclosures and known-issue/support templates.
systems: Shipping configuration, debug stripping, save compatibility, error reporting and reproducible artifact archive.
playable: Exact candidate build distributed through the intended test channel and played from a clean machine to ending.
tests: Clean install and offline launch, missing/corrupt save, full disk, input devices, ending resume and update from supported prior save.
problems: Development-only dependency, incorrect build hash, absent notice, store claim not matching game, new last-minute content regression.
exit_gate: Zero open ship-blocking defects; evidence and sign-offs archived; rollback candidate exists and support owner is assigned.

title: Final production build and launch
build: Sign off the exact shipping build, archive source/build provenance and perform release smoke checks. Release only after gates, not merely because the week arrives.
assets: Approved executable/content, storefront assets, credits and support documentation.
systems: All shipping services/configuration and local save behavior verified in final distribution form.
playable: Public release candidate identical to signed artifact; complete campaign and settings available offline.
tests: Final install/continue/new-game/critical scenes/ending smoke on distribution build; verify no content differs from approved candidate.
problems: Wrong package uploaded, accidental debug flag, launch hotfix without regression, unowned support queue.
exit_gate: Director, technical lead, producer and QA approve artifact hash; rollback and hotfix triage are ready; no known blocker waived by schedule alone.

title: Reserve, stabilization and post-release review
build: Use reserve before launch when gates slip; otherwise handle verified defects, compatibility reports and a production retrospective. No unplanned expansion is assumed.
assets: Targeted corrected assets only; archived repro saves and support captures.
systems: Hotfix branch, regression selection, save migration safety and release notes.
playable: Stable supported build; fixes preserve existing player progress and canonical ending.
tests: Every fix includes reproducible test plus affected chapter/root/save regression; monitor patterns rather than isolated preference.
problems: Reserve consumed by scope growth, risky engine upgrade, patch invalidates saves, reactive redesign of locked story.
exit_gate: Critical issues resolved or transparently documented; final archive and retrospective identify maintainable owners and future port decision.
